evidence: The repair branch preserved the existing Skill/domain structure and changed only evidence, safety-routing, access-control, and installer paths backed by concrete defects.

The historical green suite was decomposed into aggregate-runner integrity, evidence-target fidelity, production RiskDetector behavior, server auth-path behavior, and installer mutation behavior instead of being accepted as one green claim.
A remote repair branch now contains bounded candidate fixes, but exact-head repository execution is not available in the current host, so implementation presence is not promoted into verified repair.

Targeted logic candidates were exercised locally before remote mutation, but the exact remote branch cannot currently be cloned/executed in this host and GitHub-hosted Actions are intentionally not used because monetary cost is not authorized.

After each repair slice the project was rescanned: shadow tests exposed runtime behavior drift; safety routing exposed duplicate decision ownership; auth exposed fail-open runtime paths; installer exposed host guessing and destructive force semantics.
